meta.label: ASHLAR · Prologue · The Old Face (hầm xương)

generator.name: hand-authored (env/oldFace.js + OldFaceDecor)
generator.note: nothing is random at load time: the decor was built once and read back

code.note: sha256 of the listed lab source files at export time; labCommit = lookdev-lab HEAD; uncommitted = listed files that differ from HEAD (the export used the working tree)

coordinateSystem.system: three.js right-handed, Y up, metres. x = east, z = south (the default game camera looks north), y = height above the ground datum (water level 0 unless the map says otherwise).
coordinateSystem.yaw: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees, three.js Object3D.rotation.y (positive turns +z toward +x: a piece whose front is local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west).
coordinateSystem.note: the dry floor is y = 0, the flooded basin -0.4, the water surface -0.18, the stair landing +1.8

terrain.note: floor height at cell centres; NaN = no floor (outside the rooms, 0.2 m under the walls, and the stair column x 12..15.4, z < 1.5 which has its own stair mesh)

heightfield.sample: cell centre: x = x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell, z = z0 + (j + 0.5) * cell

splat.note: splat1 B is unused; layer 0 (the first of layers) covers everything

shore.note: polylines of [x, z]: the water edge on the west (x0) and east (x1) side; the water lies between them, depth = water level - floor height (the heightfield already has the basin carved)

water.note: the shore is the pair of polylines in `shore`; depth = level - floor height

textures.decalsNote: 4 x 4 atlas, cell = row * 4 + col from the image top; a flat 1 x 1 m quad on the ground scaled by size

vertexShade.note: grey vertex colour c = lerp(1, 0.06, smoothstep(y, 1.0, 2.28)) * (0.82 + 0.18 * smoothstep(y, 0.0, 0.4)), y = the vertex height in the lab GLB frame (metres, pivot at the bottom; module 2.283 m tall); multiply the base colour by it (material.vertexColors = true). The top of the wall fades to black (no ceiling: the room dissolves into darkness); lerp(a, b, t) = a + (b - a) t; smoothstep = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep

material.why: the module is a hollow shell (open niches): seen from outside its partitions would show as black blades, so it is rendered double-sided

dressing.note: everything the decor builds that is not a GLB: procedural meshes (three.js geometry type + parameters), instanced groups, ground decals (flat quads), flames (billboards). World transforms, Euler order YXZ in degrees.

lighting.defaultNote: the scene opens (and Play uses) this mood; the others are the lab's lighting presets of the same scene

hemisphereBuildColors.note: THREE.HemisphereLight(0x53627a, 0x1f2a24, 1) at build; the mood replaces sky / ground and multiplies the intensity

lighting.lightsNote: lights[] are the build-time values (cold #dce6f2 = the Wall, warm #e0a050 = Gennet's lantern); the scene multiplies them by moods[...].lightScale and flickers them (1/f noise, shimmer 1 +/- 0.06 sin over 5.3 s)
